title: Exponential mixing for the stochastic Allen--Cahn equation with localized white noise
summary: This paper studies the 1D stochastic Allen--Cahn equation on a bounded domain driven by localized white noise. We prove that the associated Markov process admits a unique invariant measure and is exponential mixing. The main challenge lies in the interaction between localized nature of the noise and non-trivial global dynamics of the system. To overcome this, our approach relies on two ingredients from PDE control theory: stabilization for the linearized system and global steady-state controllability for the nonlinear equation.
